description.value:
Frequency Once per round

Prerequisite You are adjacent to the Cart

Attempt an Athletics check of #DC#, a Survival, Crafting, or Diplomacy check of #DC-2# or a related lore check (Driving, Piloting, etc) of #DC-5#.

Each PC can attempt this check once per round, and at the end of the round, the cart moves according to the highest degree of success obtained by any PC that round.

Critical Success At the end of the round, the cart will move 30 feet.

Success At the end of the round, the cart will move 20 feet.

Failure At the end of the round, the cart will move 10 feet.

Critical Failure At the end of the round, the cart does not move.
